author: freakyphin
body:
Towers are a slow slog at the start, and take a bit to work towards,  but a rewarding eventually.

A bunch of tips -

-  ward part 1 Get as much as you can, even sacrificing +summons stuff if need be at start. I got punished in towers and then went and farmed battlegrounds for ages. Baldr battle gear has great entry gear for towers has tonnes of HP, ward and slots to get you going. Get ornates and upgrad them,  takes a while but is worth it.

- ward part 2 - hit ward of ortanite as your first action,   if you don't already, then summons. Get your prot up early. If you can fund an amity or item that auto casts ward, even better, free's up your early turns.

- your auto summons should (IMO) jinn and buggane, and the summon more bugganes as soon as you can. Jinn will clear hordes, bugganes are tanks and do great damage, will get youn through a lot of floors.

- pick your battles. Know what you can take at this stage. Avoid things like harpies, pegasus, baldr mobs that can and will hit hard and early, till you know you can tank the early rounds.
It's better to leave the tower and keep what shards you have, than die and lose half.

- wandering monsters in early levels aren't normally worth the risk vs reward, so focus on the stair bosses. That being said if it's an easy fight you know you can take, 10 shards is 10 shards.

- swap gear in and out when you need. You won't always need certain stuff equipped, but I always keep an anti petrifying accessory on hand for the Witch/gargoyle mobs to save being locked down.

If a battle is not going your way, you can quickly force close/close the app. If you are quick enough, it will save you and bump you out of the tower. You can re enter and try again, or try a different path 

Hope this helps

Edit - the summoner chest is okay, (not sure of the protection rate) but at your stage, if they hit you at all,  it's over. Like I said, focus on ward at this stage.

Edit 2  get a decent sheild. Arisen from Arisen Mammon in Horde Dungeons is great, Ymir Coiled is arguably BIS for summoners but is event locked (Dragon event just past is you have one left over)

author: Enough-Bike7525
body:
Get that Baldr gear (from Baldr, found in Battlegrounds dungeon) for high HP/ward, definitely a must! If you're too squishy, might wanna consider swapping from Benefactor to something hardier, like Capharact. As for summons Jinn is decent but it's hard to get out... Chimera is personally one of my faves given the amount of status effects it dishes out. Maybe a Buggane/Scarecrow combo could work as well?

Towers take time and lots of trial and error... aiming for the Mighty Griffin summon is a good goal! Stick with it and you'll get there eventually!
